title: Miners in the Cloud: Measuring and Analyzing Cryptocurrency Mining in Public Clouds
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical measurement and analysis of cryptocurrency mining activities in public clouds, including the detection of malicious activities. While it addresses security risks and illicit activities, this is from a technical security perspective (e.g., identifying compromised instances, ransomware, cryptojacking) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study.
